Position Overview

The Chief Sustainability Officer (CSO) is responsible for leading the organization's environmental, social, and governance (ESG) strategy and sustainability initiatives. The CSO drives the integration of sustainable business practices into corporate strategy, operations, risk management, and stakeholder engagement. This role ensures the organization meets regulatory requirements, sustainability goals, and long-term ESG commitments while enhancing corporate reputation and business resilience.

Key Responsibilities

ESG & Sustainability Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's ESG and sustainability strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Establish sustainability goals, targets, and long-term roadmaps.
  • Integrate ESG principles into business operations, investments, and decision-making processes.

Environmental Sustainability Initiatives

  • Lead initiatives focused on carbon reduction, energy efficiency, waste management, and climate resilience.
  • Develop strategies to reduce environmental impact and support net-zero objectives.
  • Monitor environmental performance metrics and sustainability benchmarks.

Social Impact & Corporate Responsibility

  • Drive diversity, equity, inclusion (DEI), employee well-being, and community engagement initiatives.
  • Oversee corporate social responsibility (CSR) programs and social impact strategies.
  • Promote ethical business practices and stakeholder trust.

Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with ESG-related regulations, reporting standards, and frameworks.
  • Establish governance policies and sustainability reporting structures.
  • Collaborate with legal, risk, compliance, and audit teams on ESG governance.

ESG Reporting & Analytics

  • Oversee ESG disclosures, sustainability reporting, and impact measurement.
  • Ensure alignment with recognized frameworks such as GRI, SASB, TCFD, and ISSB where applicable.
  • Develop dashboards and KPIs to measure ESG performance and progress.

Stakeholder & Investor Engagement

  • Engage with investors, regulators, clients, and external stakeholders on sustainability matters.
  • Communicate ESG initiatives, progress, and impact transparently.
  • Represent the organization in sustainability forums and industry discussions.

Sustainable Business Transformation

  • Collaborate with business units to embed sustainability into operations, products, and services.
  • Support sustainable finance, green initiatives, and responsible investment strategies.
  • Identify opportunities for innovation and sustainable growth.

Risk Management & Resilience

  • Assess environmental and social risks impacting business operations and investments.
  • Develop climate risk and sustainability risk management frameworks.
  • Support enterprise resilience and long-term sustainability planning.

Leadership & Culture Development

  • Promote a sustainability-focused culture across the organization.
  • Lead and mentor ESG, sustainability, and CSR teams.
  • Drive employee awareness and engagement in sustainability initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Business Administration, Finance, or related field; Master's degree preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of experience in sustainability, ESG, corporate responsibility, or related leadership roles.
  • Strong understanding of ESG frameworks, sustainability reporting, and regulatory requirements.
  • Proven track record of implementing enterprise-wide sustainability initiatives.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong strategic and sustainability leadership capabilities.
  • Expertise in ESG frameworks and sustainability reporting.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
  • Analytical and risk assessment abilities.
  • Change management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Performance Metrics

  • Achievement of ESG and sustainability targets.
  • Reduction in environmental impact and carbon footprint.
  • ESG ratings and reporting compliance.
  • Stakeholder and investor engagement outcomes.
  • Success of sustainability and CSR initiatives.

Clean luxury. Better for you. At Everlane, we believe luxury should be as effortless as it is conscious. We partner with ethical factories, work with premium, sustainably sourced materials, and strive to leave the industry cleaner than we found it. There's still much to do, and we're excited to grow a team of motivated humans ready for the challenge. The journey toward better continues.

The Sustainability team at Everlane is responsible for developing and executing the sustainability strategy to ‘Keep Earth Clean, Keep Earth Cool, and Do Right by People’ across the company’s value chain and operations. Our strategy encompasses our social impact and environmental responsibility efforts and goals across the materials we use, the factories we partner with, the way our stores and offices operate, and how we foster thoughtful transparency throughout our supply chain. The team is highly cross-functional, collaborating regularly with Supply Chain and Product teams, Marketing and Creative, Retail Ops, EPDD, and external suppliers, vendors, and industry organizations.

The Senior Manager of Sustainability will report to the VP of Product Development and Sourcing and play a key role in driving the execution and evolution of Everlane’s sustainability strategy. You will focus on delivering against current commitments—including Renew, Organic Cotton, and carbon reduction—while supporting the development of future initiatives in partnership with cross-functional teams.

You will work closely with Raw Materials, Product Development, Sourcing, Marketing, and external partners to integrate sustainability into product creation, vendor management, and brand storytelling. This role balances hands-on program ownership with cross-functional influence, ensuring sustainability goals are actionable, measurable, and embedded across the business.

Your day-to-day:

  • Own the execution of Everlane’s sustainability roadmap across key pillars including climate, water, waste, and circularity
  • Drive progress against existing commitments (e.g., Renew, Organic Cotton, carbon footprint reduction), ensuring clear tracking and accountability
  • Translate high-level sustainability goals into actionable programs, timelines, and deliverables
  • Partner with Raw Materials and Product Development to integrate lower-impact materials and processes into product lines
  • Partner with factories, mills, and third-party vendors to ensure alignment with Everlane’s environmental and social standards
  • Support and evolve vendor compliance programs, including data collection, performance tracking, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Own the development of quarterly and annual sustainability reporting, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and clarity
  • Support implementation and management of systems to track environmental and social compliance data
  • Partner with Marketing and Creative to support sustainability storytelling, including updates to the sustainability website
  • Collaborate with Workplace and Retail teams to embed sustainability practices across physical spaces
  • Provide regular updates to internal stakeholders and leadership on progress and key initiatives
  • Represent Everlane in industry conversations, conferences, and working groups as needed
  • Stay informed on sustainability trends, innovations, and regulatory changes, bringing insights back to the business

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 7+ years of experience in sustainability, corporate responsibility or a related field
  • Experience executing sustainability programs within supply chain, materials, or product-focused environments
  • Working knowledge of environmental and social compliance frameworks and reporting standards
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to drive multiple initiatives simultaneously
  • Feels comfortable speaking in large groups and with the press
  • A natural love for market research and benchmarking and rigorous about staying informed on the latest technology and trends in sustainability
  • Passionate about global sustainability and making a long-term impact in our climate

The Fine Print:

Remote Positions: This is a fully remote position. Please note: We are only accepting applications from those who file their taxes in one of the following states: California, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kansas, Massachusetts, Minnesota, North Carolina, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, and Washington.

California Residents: At Everlane, we carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. The annual compensation range for this role is $105,000 - $143,000. This range is based on the Los Angeles geographic area and the actual pay may vary depending on your skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

Position Description:

The Senior Sustainability Consultant leads and manages a portfolio of client engagements focused on corporate and product impact inventory development, target setting and tracking, and sustainability strategy development and implementation. This role serves as a key client contact, translates sustainability challenges into actionable analytical work, and leverages Bureau Veritas and Aligned Incentives tools, including AITrack, to deliver strategic insights and practical solutions.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and project manage a portfolio of customer engagements, including corporate and product impact inventories, target setting, tracking, and sustainability strategy implementation.
  • Serve as the primary client contact for assigned engagements, maintaining regular communication and visiting primary customers as appropriate.
  • Understand client sustainability challenges and translate business needs into clear analytical plans, deliverables, and recommendations.
  • Coordinate the proper flow of information to clients regarding products, services, timelines, deliverables, and project status.
  • Perform and oversee analytical tasks, including data collection, data processing, corporate inventory development, product footprinting, strategy analysis, report generation, documentation, and quality assurance/control.
  • Provide strategic advisory services that help clients set, track, and achieve sustainability-related targets.
  • Support growth within the existing client portfolio by identifying additional service opportunities and delivering high-quality client engagement.
  • Partner with Sales on new customer acquisition by providing technical support in sales meetings, scoping work, drafting proposals, and developing pricing inputs.
  • Develop client-facing deliverables such as technical documentation, analytical insight summaries, methodology materials, reports, and slide decks.
  • Support clients preparing for third-party assurance of corporate inventories and related sustainability disclosures.
  • Use Bureau Veritas and Aligned Incentives analytical tools and platforms to derive insights and support client decision-making.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Service Manager.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Expert knowledge of major sustainability market drivers and reporting frameworks, including the Greenhouse Gas Protocol (GHGP), Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi), and International Sustainability Standards Board (ISSB).
  • Expertise in Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 corporate greenhouse gas accounting.
  • Strong sustainability consulting skills, including client relationship management, project management, strategic advisory, and problem solving.
  • Ability to develop, analyze, and communicate corporate inventories, product footprints, target-setting pathways, and financially driven sustainability strategies.
  • Experience modeling impact mitigation interventions and developing marginal abatement cost curves.
  • Strong data collection, survey, assessment, analysis, reporting, and quality assurance skills.
  • Advanced business writing and presentation skills, including technical documents, client-facing slide decks, methodology documentation, and instructional materials.
  • Ability to support sales activities through technical input, proposal writing, scoping, price quotations, and customer solutioning.
  • Experience in technology, apparel/textiles, agriculture, or other supply-chain intensive sectors preferred.
  • Experience with third-party assurance support for corporate inventories preferred.
  • Familiarity with life cycle assessment, life cycle inventory database development, renewable energy markets, and opportunity identification preferred.
  • Programming or analytical skills in R, Python, SQL, Power BI, or similar tools preferred.

Competency:

  • Client Focus: Builds trusted relationships, understands client needs, and delivers practical sustainability solutions.
  • Strategic Thinking: Connects sustainability data, business objectives, regulatory trends, and market drivers to actionable strategies.
  • Project Leadership: Plans, organizes, and drives multiple client engagements to timely and high-quality completion.
  • Analytical Thinking: Interprets complex datasets and sustainability methods to produce accurate insights and recommendations.
  • Communication: Explains technical sustainability concepts clearly through meetings, reports, presentations, and client materials.
  • Business Development Mindset: Identifies growth opportunities, supports proposal development, and partners effectively with Sales.
  • Problem Solving: Addresses ambiguous client, data, methodology, or implementation issues with sound judgment.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively with sustainability, financial, IT, data science, software, sales, and client teams.
  • Quality Orientation: Ensures deliverables are accurate, well-documented, and aligned with applicable standards and client expectations.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Quickly learns new sectors, sustainability topics, tools, and client environments.
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: Takes initiative, identifies improvements, and contributes to growth in a fast-paced environment.
  • Integrity and Accountability: Documents assumptions, manages commitments, and uses client data responsibly.

Education, Certifications and Experience:

  • Master's degree in a sustainability-related field with a heavy focus on environmental impact accounting, environmental engineering, strategy development, or a related discipline preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree may be considered with demonstrated subject matter expertise and at least seven (7) years of proven experience developing and leading a portfolio of sustainability consulting engagements.
  • Demonstrated experience leading sustainability consulting engagements with end-to-end responsibility for project management, client relations, problem solving, proposal writing, price quotations, and revenue growth with existing customers.
  • Demonstrated experience with sustainability frameworks and market drivers such as GHGP, SBTi, ISSB, and Scope 1, 2, and 3 accounting.
  • Demonstrated experience collecting, analyzing, and reporting assessment and survey data.
  • Experience developing client-facing deliverables, including technical documentation, methodology materials, analytical summaries, and presentation decks.
  • Experience supporting corporate inventory assurance, financially driven sustainability strategies, and supply-chain sustainability engagements preferred.

Out of many, One Goodwill (Advancing our mission together)

We are committed to being part of the solutions, leaning into courageous conversations, and providing inclusive spaces and equal opportunities for real change in all of our endeavors. Our diversified reflection shall shine as one Goodwill.

Be bold, learn and grow (Agility)

We are open, creative, innovative, agile and willing to take risks. We operate with a sense of urgency, without rushing for the sake of speed. We are one unified team that succeeds and stumbles, and learns and grows together with humility and grace.
